title: A kind of assembled item (D565)
description: One file a kind, assets/data/kinds/<kind>.json: everything about a weapon or tool that is not its parts (docs/assembled-items.md, Kinds and The connection-point convention). Every situation is filled: a fact, a named mechanism, or open with its owner and reason; a blank or an unexplained open is refused. Read by the kind check (tools/items/kind.ts) and the part checker (tools/items/part.ts), and at run time by the assembler (D565 step 2), none of them built yet.

attach_kind.description: Its kind in the attachment contract (D546, tools/characters/attach_kinds.json): how its look is made and put on.

hold_class.description: items.ron's hold.class (holding.md section 1): which move sets it plays. null with a why for a look that has none.

hands.description: Which hands may hold it: holding.md's hold.grip (Main, Either, Off, Two), or open.

lead.description: The hand its grip rides in, main or off, mirrored on a left-handed body (D463, holding.md Mirroring).

grip_type.description: How the fingers close (D562): power in hand, hook hung, strap (no finger layer; the strap's arm).

slots.description: Its parts: one working part (head, blade, board, stave or body), one handle unless the working part carries its own, and at most two trims (D565 answer 2).

points.description: Where the item's own points come from (assembled-items.md, The connection-point convention): its grip, second grip and working edge.

held.description: In hand and ready: the stance's guard (holding.md, the hold layer's ready).

carried.description: In hand, walking about, not fighting: the carry rule (D564) or a carry pose (D560).

blocking.description: Blocking with it, where that applies (the shield targets D554, a guard on a blade D461).

animation.description: Its move set (assets/data/moves/<class>.<stance>.ron, D459), or none yet.

reference.description: The item its class's clips are made for (D459's reference, assembled-items.md Through the animations), each number with its source.

envelope.description: What an assembled item of the kind may be, round its reference: D459's tempo clamp (0.85 to 1.15) is the binding rule, I within [I_ref/1.15^2, I_ref/0.85^2]; length, head mass and balance are that band seen one number at a time, the others at the reference's. The assembler refuses an item outside it.

open.description: Something not decided or not there yet: who decides (the developers for design, D412; technical for an agent) and why it is open.

fact.description: A value and where it comes from; or open, with who decides and why.

number.description: A technical number and its source; or open with why.

range.description: A [low, high] band and its source; or open with why.

made_by.description: A model made once to its template (the models skill), or code from numbers (a haft, a string).

fits.description: The part types that may go in it (assembled-items.md, Part types).

joins.description: Which of its connection points meets which of its partner's.

point_rule.description: How one of the item's points comes from its parts' points, or does not apply (with why), or open.

situation.description: How the item is in one situation: built (in the game today), decided (by a live decision, not built), open (with its owner and why) or does not apply (with why). Built and decided name their mechanism and decisions.

mechanism.description: hand_socket: in hand on its lead hand's socket (D546); hung: hung from the hand (D546); strap: on the forearm (terra_walker::strap, D554); carry_rule: tipped by the carry rule (D546, D564); carry_pose: a fight.json clip laid on its arm while carried (D560); stowed_socket: a body socket when put away (D551); shield_targets: the board's place per shield pose, the arm solved to it (D554); move_set: a set's clips (D459); tool_use: the walker's use and strike clips (terra_walker::figure); none yet: nothing exists for it.
